_doc: Shape for apps/<slug>/page.config.json. Slot-filled into apps/_template/page.html by build.mjs. Keys are listed in order of importance. Comment keys (anything starting with _) are ignored by the build.
title: Page title
meta_description: Under 160 chars. Appears in <meta name=description> and og:description.
lede: One-sentence lede that sits under the H1 in the GoA page header.
_doc_html_classes: html_class only needs the 'js' modernizr-style class. Other strings like goa-stats-template are vestigial from the upstream template and have no effect — keep the default unless you have a reason.

breadcrumbs.label: This page (last item — no href, renders as <span>)

parent._doc: Optional. Renders the 'Part of …' link above the H1 on sub-pages of a program. Only used when there is no hero (hero blocks do not include the parent link).
parent.label: Section name

hero._doc: Optional. When set, the page header renders as the alberta.ca hero-banner pattern (background image + dark gradient + large title + lede), matching pages like /all-services and /technology-and-innovation. When omitted, the page header is the standard text-only block. The breadcrumb is rendered in both cases. Keep TITLE under 60 chars and LEDE under 160 for legibility against the photo.

sidebar._doc: Optional. When present, renders the .goa-sidebar-content nav. Use the SAME sidebar across every page of a multi-page program and flip current:true on the link matching that page's slug. eyebrow defaults to 'Explore pages in:' if omitted.
sidebar.heading: Program name
